title: Natural automorphism adjustment of the K-flat pullback counit to the supplied translated-unit shift
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of Noetherian schemes with recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe. Let F=Lf* be derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] with a supplied strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and let H be the homotopy functor induced by additive termwise tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write Qh_X for localization and c_X(K):O_X[1]⊗K≅K[1] for the canonical shift-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. Fix a natural transformation ε₀:Qh_Y⋙F→H⋙Qh_Z invertible at each K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex]. There exist an isomorphism e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] and a natural automorphism a of Qh_Y⋙F. Put ε=a.hom≫ε₀ and G=H⋙Qh_Z. For every homotopy object X, ε(X[1])≫commShift_G(X) equals F(commShift_Qh_Y(X))≫b(Qh_Y(X))≫ε(X)[1], where b(K) is F(c_Y(K) inverse), followed by the supplied inverse tensorator at (O_Y[1],K), e tensor identity, and c_Z(F(K)). This is a shift-square normalization, with no mapping-cone assertion.

source.place: Lemma 20.27.1, K-flat computation; supplied-tensorator normalization in parent cone step 3, expanded by the agent (not a literal assertion of Tag 06YJ).

proof.text: Apply the normalized representative-counit theorem to obtain e, ε, K-flat invertibility and the shift square on K-flat representatives.

Prove naturality of the canonical shift-unit comparison from the canonical two-variable tensor shift, left-unitor naturality and shift_app_comm. Invert that comparison and use inverse-tensorator naturality and whisker exchange to obtain a natural transformation b with the displayed translated-unit components. Form the two sides of the shift square as natural transformations l and r.

For any homotopy object take a complex representative and a K-flat resolution P→K. Qh inverts the augmentation; naturality of its shift comparison implies that Qh also sends the shifted augmentation to an isomorphism. Thus the common source of l and r sends the augmentation to an isomorphism. Cancel it, use naturality of l and r and the known equality at P, to prove their equality at K.
Apply the proved counit factorization theorem to ε₀ and ε. Substitute ε=a.hom≫ε₀ into the equality of the two natural-transformation components, proving the original statement verbatim.
